their_protocol: 5-fold PATIENT-LEVEL cross-validation on all 27,558 images; mean +/- std over folds

ours.protocol: single held-out 10% test (2,758 images), cluster bootstrap by patient/smear code (201 clusters)

reasoning: Point accuracy 0.9608 vs 0.957 is +0.38pp, but our CI95 lower bound (0.9522) sits below their mean (0.957): intervals overlap -> no statistically defensible beat.
Protocols differ (single held-out test vs 5-fold patient CV) - cross-protocol number comparison is indicative only, not a matched beat.
